operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates an existing **brand**.

The brand id is supplied both in the path **and** in the request body — send the same value in both. `name` is the only editable field; it is **required** and must remain **unique** across the account.

> Always include `id` in the body. If the body omits `id`, the request does not update the record — it creates a new brand instead (while still reporting success).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The brand id to update. Send the same value in the request body.

id.description: Required. The id of the brand to update; must match the id in the URL path.

name.description: Required. The new brand name. Must be unique across the account (a duplicate name is rejected).

id.description: The id of the updated brand.

400.description: Validation failed — the `name` is empty or already used by another brand.

errors.description: Field-keyed validation messages. Each key maps to an array of human-readable messages.

name.description: Validation messages for `name`, e.g. `This is a required field and could not be empty` (empty) or `This Field Already Exist` (duplicate).
